subject: EdgeCloud private VPC — cert rotation & ops clarification
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes To: Irene Choi , Karthik Iyer Cc: Marcus Pike Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700 Subject: EdgeCloud private VPC onboarding — cert rotation & ops questions Hi Irene / Karthik, Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. As we start prep for the EdgeCloud private VPC cutover, a few items popped up from our networking and security teams that we want to align on before the architecture review call: - Control plane reachability model: do you prefer a single TLS-based control plane endpoint in our VPC, or a pair of regional endpoints? Any implications for cert lifecycle? - Certificate rotation: we run quarterly rotations; does Redwood support a rolling CA rotation that avoids client downtime, or do you require scheduled maintenance windows? - KMS/HSM integration: we need to understand if Redwood can use our customer-managed KMS (Azure Key Vault / HSM) for control-plane keys. - Egress constraints: our SOC team requires a short list of outbound destinations and ports for the control plane so they can add to the allowlist. Can you share a reference diagram and a short cert-rotation playbook? If useful, we can do a 30 minute deep-dive on Mon/Tue to go over specifics. Attachments requested: reference diagram + cert rotation example. - Olivia Olivia Barnes Head of Platform Integrations EdgeCloud Solutions From: Irene Choi To: Olivia Barnes , Karthik Iyer Cc: Hannah Schmitt , Marcus Lin Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700 Subject: Re: EdgeCloud private VPC onboarding — cert rotation & ops questions Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely cover all of this. Quick answers up-front and then I attached a high-level reference diagram to save time: EdgeCloud-VPC-reference-diagram.png (see attachment). Quick notes: - Control plane endpoints: the recommended pattern for private deployments is a pair of regional control-plane endpoints (active/standby) fronted by regional load balancers. That gives you failover without DNS TTL churn. Customer can pin to a single endpoint if they want lower operational complexity. - Cert rotation: Redwood supports rolling rotations with zero-client downtime when mutual TLS is used and you run parallel certs for the overlap window (we call this the two-certificate handoff). We will share a short playbook (PDF) with steps and expected maintenance windows if you can't accept rolling overlap. - KMS/HSM: we offer integrations with customer-managed KMS providers. You can bring keys into Azure Key Vault; we support decrypt-on-use patterns and HSM-backed signing for control-plane certs. Details vary by region and the private deployment model (VPC vs air-gapped). - Egress/ports: see annotated diagram (attached) and the short ports list below. Ports/outbound endpoints (summary): - TCP 443 to control-plane egress LB (region-specific FQDNs) - 1194/UDP (optional) for WireGuard if you choose peer tunnels for data-plane egress - 5222/TCP for telemetry agent to our collector (TLS) Next steps: 1) Can you confirm preferred control-plane model (single vs regional)? 2) Pick two 30-min slots Mon/Tue and I’ll send a calendar invite with the call agenda and SOW draft. Attaching: EdgeCloud-VPC-reference-diagram.png Thanks, Irene Choi Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference From: Karthik Iyer To: Olivia Barnes , Irene Choi Cc: Hannah Schmitt , Marcus Lin Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 08:22:00 -0700 Subject: Re: EdgeCloud private VPC onboarding — cert rotation & ops questions Hi Olivia — adding a few technical specifics that ops/security will want to see on the call. 1) Control plane (recommended): - Two regional control-plane endpoints (active/standby) behind ALBs. Control plane uses mTLS with client cert verification. - We support SAN certificates that list the ALB FQDNs and an internal subject name. - For zones with strict egress, we can provide a per-customer NAT egress IP pool (static) so you can allowlist addresses. 2) Certificate rotation patterns: - Rolling overlap (preferred): issue new certs and deploy them alongside existing certs for a configurable overlap (48–72 hours). The runtime accepts both old+new certs during overlap and transitions traffic. No client restart required. - Maintenance window (fallback): if the customer policy forbids overlap, we schedule a short maintenance window where the control-plane presents only the new cert. Expected impact: dependent services should revalidate; typical disruption is under 2 minutes if clients perform cert re-handshake quickly. 3) KMS/HSM options: - API-based integration with Azure Key Vault and AWS KMS. For HSM-backed signing, we do a signing proxy that calls your HSM with ephemeral credentials. - We recommend storing long-lived CA material in your KMS and provisioning short-lived leaf certs from Redwood during deployment. 4) Egress/ports (complete): - TCP 443 to control-plane.
- TCP 443 to telemetry endpoints (collector.redwood.com:443). - UDP/TCP as required for optional WireGuard peer tunnels (configurable). Attachments in the follow-up: I’ll draft a cert-rotation playbook and a suggested overlap schedule for your SOC to review. —Karthik Karthik Iyer Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference From: Olivia Barnes To: Irene Choi , Karthik Iyer Cc: Marcus Pike Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 11:47:00 -0700 Subject: Re: EdgeCloud private VPC onboarding — cert rotation & ops questions Thanks both — that helps a lot. A couple follow-ups before the call: - For the per-customer NAT pool: what is the lead time and what IP range sizes do you support? We need to size the allowlist. - For HSM-backed signing: our legal team will want to see the KMS contract language and any request/response logs you retain. Can you send the KMS integration spec and the minimal audit fields? We can do Monday 2026-05-11 09:00–09:30 PDT or Tuesday 2026-05-12 17:00–17:30 PDT. Prefer Monday. Please send calendar invite if that works. —Olivia From: Marcus Lin To: Irene Choi , Karthik Iyer , Hannah Schmitt Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700 Subject: Internal: EdgeCloud cert rotation plan + SOW draft (for review) Team — attaching a draft cert-rotation playbook and SOW we can share on the call. Key callouts: - Proposed rotation window (if customer forbids overlap): 02:00–02:10 UTC; operations script includes automatic rekey + health checks (timed retries). - Rolling overlap plan: default to 72-hour overlap with automated health-check promotion at 24/48/72h markers. - KMS/HSM: the draft includes the HSM signing proxy flow and a minimal audit log schema (timestamp, operation, request-id, principal-id). Legal will likely request more retention detail. Attachments: cert-rotation-plan.pdf, RWI-4567-SOW-draft.docx Please review and flag anything that needs redaction before external distribution (particularly any internal endpoints or account IDs). I’ll iterate and upload the next version to the Drive link. Thanks, Marcus Lin Infra Ops Lead, Redwood Inference From: Irene Choi To: Olivia Barnes , Marcus Pike Cc: Karthik Iyer , Hannah Schmitt , Marcus Lin Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 15:40:00 -0700 Subject: Re: EdgeCloud private VPC onboarding — cert rotation & ops questions Olivia — confirming Monday 2026-05-11 09:00 PDT for a 30-min deep-dive. Calendar invite sent (please accept). Agenda attached to invite: reference diagram walk, cert-rotation playbook highlights, KMS/HSM integration checklist, and next steps for SOW signoff. Per your asks: - NAT pool sizing: typical lead time is 3 business days; we support /29–/24 depending on scale. Marcus will share the exact allocation recommendations in the call. - KMS audit fields: we support a minimal schema (operation, principal, timestamp, request-id, result). If you need additional fields, we can enumerate with Legal on the call. Attached to this message for convenience: cert-rotation-plan.pdf, EdgeCloud-VPC-reference-diagram.png, RWI-4567-SOW-draft.docx Looking forward to the call — we’ll aim to have an updated SOW version and the cert-rotation playbook posted to the Drive after the meeting. Best, Irene Choi Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference Attachments: cert-rotation-plan.pdf (application/pdf), EdgeCloud-VPC-reference-diagram.png (image/png), RWI-4567-SOW-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
